verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that codes generate without an internet connection or mobile service, and that the app offers a 'Use without an account' option on first launch, so a Google Account sync is optional. The GitHub project confirms standard RFC 6238 TOTP generation, and community reports of device-to-device QR export suggest local-only use is workable. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that code generation is fully offline in account-less mode.
